title: A (very) slow fish tank
author: AmphibianHungry2466
selftext:
build this to entertain my kids ... and distract them from the fact they want a pet rock ... I mean a dog. 

Honestly I'm having more fun building the they have had. 

I used Claude Code, and Higgsfield CLI for the 3D models. 

[https://tanksimulator.fish](https://tanksimulator.fish)

So far I have received great feedback I have ignored:

1. I'm mixing fish that should not mix
2. The tank is to small for the fish
3. The fishes are too big
4. The snails movement is unrealistic (when compared to GTA 6)

I did fix the snails ... because I don't have a PS5.

  
Any workflows to do the 3D models without paying an 3rd party service?
